2607.04713.title: RSPO: Reward-Swap Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
2607.04713.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning holds significant potential for training large language models (LLMs) to handle multi-turn interactive tasks. However, in long-horizon, multi-turn tasks characterized by sparse outcome rewards, directly training with outcome rewards often results in slow convergence due to the sparsity of signals and the lack of fine-grained feedback. Furthermore, the model may fail to learn successful trajectories that are not sampled during training, thereby limiting its performance. Conversely, while employing customized dense process rewards provides richer signals and accelerates convergence, these surrogate rewards may exhibit potential misalignment with the ground-truth outcome rewards. This inconsistency can bias the training direction and ultimately degrade the model's final performance. In this work, we propose Reward-Swap Policy Optimization (RSPO), a method designed to leverage the rich information from dense process rewards to facilitate training with outcome rewards. By utilizing a reward-swap mechanism, RSPO ensures the diversity of sampled trajectories while guaranteeing consistency between the optimization objective and the true outcome rewards, thereby elevating the performance ceiling of the model. We conduct extensive experiments on two challenging agent benchmarks, WebShop and ALFWorld. By applying our method to various reinforcement learning algorithms, including GRPO, PPO, and GiGPO, we demonstrate that RSPO achieves consistent performance improvements across different baselines and benchmarks.
2607.04713.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習在訓練大型語言模型（LLMs）以處理多輪互動任務方面具有重要潛力。<lb/>然而，在以稀疏結果獎勵為特徵的長期多輪任務中，直接使用結果獎勵進行訓練往往會因信號稀疏和缺乏細緻反饋而導致收斂緩慢。<lb/>此外，模型可能無法學習在訓練期間未被抽樣的成功軌跡，從而限制其性能。<lb/>相反，雖然使用定制的密集過程獎勵可以提供更豐富的信號並加速收斂，但這些替代獎勵可能與真實的結果獎勵存在潛在的不一致。<lb/>這種不一致可能會偏向訓練方向，最終降低模型的最終性能。<lb/>在本研究中，我們提出了獎勵交換政策優化（RSPO），這是一種旨在利用密集過程獎勵中的豐富信息來促進使用結果獎勵進行訓練的方法。<lb/>通過利用獎勵交換機制，RSPO確保了抽樣軌跡的多樣性，同時保證了優化目標與真實結果獎勵之間的一致性，從而提升了模型的性能上限。<lb/>我們在兩個具有挑戰性的代理基準上進行了廣泛的實驗，分別是WebShop和ALFWorld。<lb/>通過將我們的方法應用於各種強化學習算法，包括GRPO、PPO和GiGPO，我們證明了RSPO在不同基準和基準測試中實現了一致的性能提升。
